target: acceptance 4 — claim refuses a dark spec specifically. A valid spec in the same queue is still claimed, which is what distinguishes 'dark is refused' from 'claim is broken for everything'.
cmd: mkdir -p s; cp "$FIXTURES/profile/dark.md" s/901-dark.md; cp "$FIXTURES/profile/standard.md" s/902-ok.md; out=$(FACTORY_SPECS_DIR="$PWD/s" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" claim specd building t 2>/dev/null); c=$?; dk=$(grep -m1 "^status:" s/901-dark.md | sed "s/status: //"); ok=$(grep -m1 "^status:" s/902-ok.md | sed "s/status: //"); printf '{"c":%s,"claimed":"%s","dark":"%s","valid":"%s"}' "$c" "$(basename "$out")" "$dk" "$ok"
